purpose: Four different reclining poses in the user's chosen simplified orange and green app icon style

variants.label: D — Moon curl
variants.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: new macOS application icon concept for TrayNook.
Input Image 1: the user's selected icon; use as the EXACT CHARACTER, COLOR PALETTE, and RENDERING STYLE reference. Create a substantially NEW COMPOSITION according to the variant below, rather than merely mirroring, recoloring, or reproducing its pose.
Keep: warm orange/apricot continuous-corner square/squircle background; original tanuki mascot in caramel/copper brown, cream cheeks and charcoal eye patches; green inbox tray with pale mint rim and a visible central notch; cozy sleeping expression. The tanuki is lying down or curled and embraces the tray like a beloved pillow.
Rendering: polished simplified low-relief illustration like the reference, smooth clean broad shapes, very restrained soft shading. Low detail. No fur strands, fuzzy silhouette, grain, material texture, photo realism, plastic gloss, fine seams, toe lines or tiny highlights. Eyes are two clear closed arcs, with a small dark nose and tiny relaxed smile. Two small rounded ears, short broad muzzle, round dark paws, thick mostly solid brown tail, no tail stripes or white tip. Anatomy is simple and coherent: one head, two ears, two front paws.
Tray: unmistakable large simple inbox/tray icon, open upper cavity, pale green rim, green front with central U-shaped dip. Keep tray readable as a separate shape and do not hide its whole front behind the tail. It is not a bowl, serving platter, backpack, bed or basket.
Composition: one centered complete icon, all animal parts inside the squircle, consistent generous edge margin, broad readable silhouette. A single unified design, not a presentation sheet. Square output; narrow neutral outer margin outside rounded square. No text, letters, watermark, labels, props, leaves, accessories, or desktop UI. Retain orange background and green tray for direct comparison across variants.
NEW COMPOSITION D — compact moon curl, viewed from high above. Reorganize the animal into an almost circular protective crescent around a small but still clear tray at the center. The head is SMALLER than in the reference and rests at the upper-RIGHT of the tray, angled inward. Body curves across the TOP and LEFT of the central tray, forming a broad uninterrupted circular arc; thick tail finishes at lower-left. Two paws reach inward to gently hold the tray rim. This should read like a sleeping curled tanuki forming a near-ring around the inbox, quite different from the original large diagonal head and huge foreground tail. Leave some orange breathing room around the compact circular silhouette. Keep facial features large enough to read.
